candidates.title: Passport validity and Schengen entry check
candidates.summary: Confirm both passports are valid for the full stay and at least three months beyond the planned exit, and that each traveller can enter the Schengen area visa-free for up to 90 days. Ages were not answered, so I cannot say whether children's documents or consent letters apply. I have not verified current entry-system rules, so treat this as a prompt to check, not as clearance to travel.

candidates.title: Trip-cancellation and medical travel insurance
candidates.summary: Cover for a multi-country rail trip with non-refundable hotel bookings, plus emergency medical care in Austria, Slovenia and Italy. Access needs were not answered, so pre-existing conditions and mobility-related exclusions are unknown to me and should be read closely before buying. This is a cost band I have not checked against any insurer.

candidates.title: Mobile data plan for the three-country route
candidates.summary: A data eSIM or local SIM covering Austria, Slovenia and Italy would keep train tickets, timetables and hotel check-ins reachable as you move between the cities. Coverage on regional trains and in the Trieste hills was not checked, so offline maps are a sensible backup.

candidatesAccepted.title: Vienna to Ljubljana by train
candidatesAccepted.summary: A rail leg through the Alps foothills that suits a moderate-effort pace, with no internal flights needed. Ages and access needs were not answered, so I could not check step-free access or how long a changeover suits you, and I have not measured the journey time, so it is left unknown. Fares are a rough model-asserted band to be checked before anything is booked.

candidatesAccepted.title: Ljubljana to Trieste by train
candidatesAccepted.summary: A short rail hop across the Slovenian and Italian border that would work well if you drop one city and keep the other two. Ages and access needs were not answered, so I cannot say whether the border stop or platform changes are a problem for you. The journey time is unmeasured and left unknown.

candidatesAccepted.title: Vienna to Trieste by train
candidatesAccepted.summary: A direct-as-possible rail option if you would rather skip Ljubljana and keep the trip to two cities. I did not check the route or whether a change is needed, and ages and access needs were not answered, so those are unknown to me. The journey time is left unmeasured and the fare band is a model-asserted estimate.

candidatesAccepted.title: Hotel in Vienna
candidatesAccepted.summary: A hotel is the roughest night you said you would accept, and Vienna is a sensible first stop on the rail line. Your access needs and the ages in your party were not answered, so I could not check for step-free rooms, lifts, or family rooms, and I have not confirmed any particular premises. Cost is my own rough band, not a checked rate.

candidatesAccepted.title: Hotel in Ljubljana
candidatesAccepted.summary: A hotel fits your comfortable budget and the rail connection from Vienna. Ages and access needs were not answered, so I could not check accessibility or room layout, and no specific property is named. The price band is my estimate and has not been checked against current rates.

candidatesAccepted.title: Hotel in Trieste
candidatesAccepted.summary: A hotel suits the roughest night you will accept and is a reasonable base if you keep Trieste as the last stop. Ages and access needs were not answered, so I could not check those requirements. No property is named, and the price band is an unverified estimate.

candidatesAccepted.title: Schönbrunn Palace and gardens
candidatesAccepted.summary: A large Habsburg palace with formal gardens, a strong pick for a comfortable pace in Vienna. Ages and access needs were not answered, so I could not check stair or walking suitability; the grounds are large, so check accessibility before committing.

candidatesAccepted.title: Belvedere palace and art collection
candidatesAccepted.summary: Baroque palace complex with a well-regarded art collection, fitting a moderate-effort day in Vienna. Access needs were not answered, so I could not confirm step-free routes through the buildings.

candidatesAccepted.title: Ljubljana Castle and hilltop views
candidatesAccepted.summary: A hilltop castle reached by funicular or a short walk, a gentle way to see Ljubljana's old town from above. Ages were not answered, so I could not judge whether the uphill walk suits everyone; the funicular is the easier option.

candidatesAccepted.title: Miramare Castle and coastal park
candidatesAccepted.summary: A seaside castle set in a park above the Gulf of Trieste, a calm half-day with moderate walking. Access needs were not answered, and I did not check the castle's closing days, so confirm opening before planning around it.

candidatesAccepted.title: Vienna coffeehouse sit-down (a kind of place)
candidatesAccepted.summary: A traditional Viennese coffeehouse is a kind of place, not a named premises, and a long unhurried sit with cake suits a slower food-focused day. Nothing was said about what the party cannot eat and access needs were not answered, so check menus and access before going.

candidatesAccepted.title: Heuriger wine tavern evening (a kind of place)
candidatesAccepted.summary: A heuriger, the Viennese wine tavern serving young local wine and simple food, is a kind of place rather than a named premises and a good low-effort evening out. Your dietary limits were not given to me, so confirm them with the house before ordering.

candidatesAccepted.summary: A central produce market is a kind of place where you can graze on local cheese, cured meats and bread at your own pace, which fits a moderate-effort trip. I have no list of named stalls for Ljubljana and nothing on what you cannot eat, so check each stall's contents.

candidatesAccepted.title: Traditional Slovenian dinner (a kind of place)
candidatesAccepted.summary: A traditional Slovenian restaurant is a kind of place serving regional dishes such as žlikrofi and roast meats, a good anchor for a Ljubljana evening. I do not know your dietary limits or access needs, so confirm both when booking or ordering.

candidatesAccepted.title: Trieste seafood trattoria (a kind of place)
candidatesAccepted.summary: A seafood trattoria is a kind of place serving the Adriatic catch that Trieste is known for, a natural meal for a port city. Nothing was said about what you cannot eat and I have no named venues here, so check the menu for shellfish and other allergens before ordering.
